added: Each type of dance (contra, English country dance, square) now has its own dialects and its own active dialect. Choose the type at the top of Settings ▸ Dialect, and every dance reads in the dialect of its own type.
The new-dance Type setting can be Last used, so a new dance starts as the type of the last new dance you saved.
`DialectsByForm` holds the dialect each dance form is shown in; `forDance` picks a dance's.

Classify `custom_dialects_ecd`, `custom_dialects_square`, `active_dialect_ref_ecd`, `active_dialect_ref_square` and `last_used_dance_form` as shareable preferences; the two custom-dialect keys sync as whole collections.
changed: `FigureRenderer.moveWordingTemplate` seeds an English Country Dance movement's wording that saves as it stands and reads as the movement does by default: each switch group (`[{?flag}words]`) becomes the condition `[if flag then words]`, and the template's own choices (a run of changes with no count, a hey with no `who`, a forward and back with no direction) become conditions too. A wording of an ECD movement now reads its slots in ECD's words ("back to place") and leaves no space before a comma.
A wording condition on an ECD `who` (a list of dancers) is empty when the list names nobody; it read as filled before.
